hard_rules.luminance_floor: 165 for Volume I; 160 for Volumes II and III

candidates.prompt: Create premium 6x9 Christian devotional front-cover artwork in a vertical 2:3 composition. A radiant golden-hour valley beneath a broad peach-to-amber sunrise sky that fills most of the frame. A graceful Black woman in a flowing white dress sits on a natural rock in the lower middle ground, viewed from behind, quietly facing the light. A bald eagle soars above the valley with anatomically correct wings catching the sun. Sunlit wildflowers in gold, white, and soft rose frame the foreground. Rolling fresh green hills and a distant silver-gold river create depth. The emotional tone is surrender, safety, dignity, and the Father's expansive love. Refined photographic realism, cinematic high dynamic range, warm god-rays, natural detail, elegant depth, no gloomy or desert feeling. Keep the upper-center sky calm for later typography. Full bleed. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, barcode, or book mockup.
candidates.rationale: Closest to Lady D's emailed composition, with an immediate emotional center and strong shelf brightness.

candidates.prompt: Generate an emotionally powerful, bright 6x9 devotional front-cover image, portrait 2:3. In the lower foreground, a poised Black woman in a flowing ivory-white dress sits among sunlit wildflowers on a gentle overlook, seen from behind and slightly to the side with no visible facial detail. Beyond her, a vast luminous valley opens toward a golden sunrise and reflective river. A bald eagle sweeps through the upper-right light, natural and anatomically correct. Use peach, warm gold, cream, soft rose, fresh green, and a clear pale-blue edge in the sky. Strategic soft shadow may shape the dress and flowers but light dominates at least three quarters of the image. Premium photographic realism, beautiful atmospheric perspective, reverent rather than sentimental. Leave the upper-left sky quiet for later title design. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, barcode, or book mockup.
candidates.rationale: A dignified, intimate surrender image with excellent river depth and a calm typographic field.

candidates.direction: The Path Into the Father's Light
candidates.prompt: Create luminous premium 6x9 Christian devotional cover art, vertical 2:3, full bleed. A bright winding path passes through a meadow of cream, rose, and golden wildflowers toward a wide sunrise over green hills. A small Black woman in a flowing white dress, seen from behind, stands peacefully beside the path in the lower third; a bald eagle glides high in the sunlit sky. The scene must feel alive, welcoming, and safely held by the Father's love, with warm peach sky, clean cream light, fresh sage greens, beautiful distance layers, and only gentle foreground shade for depth. High-end photographic realism and cinematic HDR without artificial glow or darkness. Preserve a clear calm title zone in the upper third. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, barcode, or mockup.
candidates.rationale: The clearest journey metaphor and the brightest Volume I option, with slightly less intimacy than her seated reference.

candidates.prompt: Create a premium 6x9 devotional cover scene along a luminous first-century Judean shoreline path by the Sea of Galilee. Treat the footprints at roughly 70 percent of the visual scale used in a typical foreground-footprint cover so the path feels long and the marks remain subtle. From the lower foreground to the midpoint, show TWO DIFFERENT ADULTS' NARROW NATURAL WALKING TRAILS running close and parallel. Each person leaves an ordinary alternating gait: left sandal, then right sandal, with realistic forward spacing. The two trails do not curve together, cross, merge, converge, or form a Y. Exactly at the midpoint, one person's entire trail simply stops and disappears as if that traveler was lifted up. The other person's single alternating left-right trail continues toward the horizon. Far ahead and faint in the bright atmosphere, a dignified first-century Jewish man in a cream tunic and mantle carries another fully clothed adult safely in both arms. Use shallow, dusty pressure marks from simple ancient leather sandals: thin flat soles, slightly irregular worn edges, and at most a faint narrow strap impression. Keep every print small, lightly defined, and subordinate to the journey. No bare toes, modern tread, boots, sneakers, giant soles, deep stamped outlines, hopping pairs, or wide waddling gait. The image embodies divine companionship and the revelation that Christ carried the traveler through the hardest ground. Bright cream-gold earth, pale blue water, fresh olive green, warm dawn, premium cinematic photographic realism, calm upper sky for typography. No halo, crucifixion imagery, text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or mockup.
candidates.rationale: The complete Son-lane story now reads naturally: two restrained parallel gaits, one trail ending without convergence, and the distant carrier resolving the surviving trail.

candidates.prompt: Create premium 6x9 Christian devotional front-cover art, vertical 2:3, bright full bleed. A sequence of unmistakable natural sandal footprints begins large in a warm parchment-colored dirt path at the lower foreground and leads toward a brilliant clean sunrise. The road travels through sunlit olive groves and open green-gold fields. Dew catches the morning light. The image communicates walking daily with Jesus through companionship, guidance, and hope without showing a recognizable face or stock portrait of Jesus. Olive leaves must read luminous green and gold, never near-black. Cinematic photographic realism, high dynamic range, delicate atmosphere, graceful depth, only a thin cool-blue rim at the top. Keep the upper-middle light calm for typography. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or mockup.
candidates.rationale: The strongest retail read for the Son volume: unmistakable sandal impressions, open road, and luminous olive setting.

candidates.prompt: Generate bright, elegant 6x9 devotional cover artwork in portrait 2:3. A sun-washed road curves beneath airy olive branches whose green and silver leaves glow around the edges. Clear sandal footprints are pressed into the path and catch bands of golden dawn light as they move toward the horizon. The landscape opens rather than enclosing the viewer. Clean parchment, white-gold sun, living olive green, and a pale morning sky create a peaceful matched-trilogy palette. Refined photographic realism with tactile earth and leaf detail, confident spiritual warmth, strategic small shadows for dimensionality only. Provide a quiet open title area in the upper center. No person required. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or book mockup.
candidates.rationale: Elegant and contemplative, with a softer footprint read and especially usable upper title space.

candidates.prompt: Create a luminous premium Christian devotional cover image, 6x9 vertical 2:3. A bright field road at dawn is marked by a natural trail of sandal footprints leading forward. Sunlit grain and wild grasses move gently on both sides, with a few olive trees opening toward a clear golden horizon. At great distance, an indistinct companion figure may be suggested only as a small reverent silhouette in the light, with no identifiable face and no anatomy distortion. The focus is the footprints and the invitation to follow. Use dawn gold, parchment, clean white, fresh olive green, and a subtle cool edge in the upper sky. High-end photographic realism, radiant but natural HDR, no moody framing. Leave the upper third uncluttered. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or mockup.
candidates.rationale: The distant companion adds narrative warmth; the brighter path is distinctive but less quiet than the other two.

candidates.prompt: Create luminous high-end 6x9 devotional cover art in vertical 2:3. After a cleansing rain, a shallow stream through a fresh green meadow reflects a brilliant opening in the clouds. Golden shafts of light travel across the water. A natural white dove glides through the light and a small warm flame hovers near the bank as a sacred, gentle presence, both brighter than the surrounding scene. Receding gray-blue cloud detail is limited to the far outer edges and does not darken the image. The result should feel immersive, powerful, comforting, colorful, and full of breath and movement. Photographic realism, natural cinematic HDR, strong retail-thumbnail silhouette, calm sky zone for later title typography. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or mockup.
candidates.rationale: The richest Spirit composition: dove, flame, living water, fresh growth, and radiant after-rain light work as one scene.

candidates.prompt: Generate a bright, dynamic 6x9 Christian devotional front-cover image, portrait 2:3. Fresh meadow grasses, white flowers, and gold seed heads bend in a visible current of wind beneath radiant sunbeams. A white dove rides the current through a broad opening in pale blue clouds, while a gentle suspended golden flame forms a clear secondary focus above the field. Everything feels rain-washed, clean, moving, and filled with living presence. Use flame gold, dove white, sunlit sky blue, and fresh green; deep teal may tint only the extreme top corners. Strategic foreground shadow adds depth but never darkness. Premium photographic realism, cinematic clarity, spacious title area in the upper middle. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or book mockup.
candidates.rationale: The best expression of breath and movement, balancing the dove and flame with a living field.

candidates.prompt: Create premium 6x9 Christian devotional cover art, vertical 2:3 and full bleed. Brilliant golden sunbeams pour through widely parting clouds over a rain-fresh green meadow. A graceful white dove in anatomically correct mid-flight crosses the brightest opening, feathers luminous and natural. Below, a small gentle flame glows warmly among fresh grasses without burning them. The dove and flame are the brightest focal points. Receding clouds remain only at the outer edges; most of the frame is sunlit sky blue, dove white, fresh green, and flame gold. The mood is power, comfort, movement, and holy presence, hopeful and alive rather than stormy. Cinematic photographic realism and natural high dynamic range. Calm upper-left title zone. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or mockup.
candidates.rationale: An unmistakable Spirit-lane symbol with exceptional brightness, though the radiant center leaves less tonal range.
